Title: Don't close more than 60% of your registers

Title: Sticky after reseasoning? You used too much oil
Description: One dishwasher cycle strips cast iron's seasoning and leaves rust, but the pan survives. Lodge's fix is a scour, a thin oil coat, and an hour at 450–500°F.

Title: Dead fairy ring? It needs deep water, not fungicide
Description: Rain makes soil fungi feeding on buried wood or roots fruit. They rarely hurt grass, but one common lawn species is North America's top poisoning mushroom.
